 NFL News Roundup NFL news roundup: Bears' Cole Kmet goes on injured reserve after season-ending injury
 Published: Updated: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL. Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown. 
 READ: Week 7 injury report 
 Arizona Cardinals 2-4 SIGNINGS 
 TE Shawn Bowman (practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable to play Sunday against the Broncos.
 RB  Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is out Sunday.
 DL Walter Nolen (ankle) out
 DL Darius Robinson (back) questionable
 CB Max Melton (knee) questionable
 S Budda Baker (groin/illness) questionable
 S Andrew Wingard (knee) out
 Atlanta Falcons 2-4 ROSTER CUTS 
 DB Malcolm DeWalt IV 
 INJURIES 
 RB Brian Robinson (hamstring) is out Sunday against the 49ers.
 WR  Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) is questionable to play.
 OT Michael Jerrell (bicep) out
 DE Samson Ebukam (hamstring) questionable
 DE Za'Darius Smith (neck) questionable
 LB Divine Deablo (forearm) out
 DB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) out
 CB A.J. Terrell (groin) questionable
 CB Avieon Terrell (back) questionable
 Baltimore Ravens 4-2 INJURIES 
 QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is questionable to play Sunday against the Bengals. Jackson, who was limited in practice all week after missing the past two games, told reporters he is "heading in the right direction."
 DT Broderick Washington (ankle) questionable
 LB Tavius Robinson (pectoral) will miss the remainder of the season, head coach Jesse Minter said.
 CB T.J. Tampa (knee) is doubtful to play.
 S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) is out Sunday.
 Buffalo Bills 5-1 FINES 
 DB Sam Franklin 's one-game suspension for unsportsmanlike conduct was reduced to a $14,926 fine, the NFL announced.
 Carolina Panthers 3-2 INJURIES 
 OT Monroe Freeling (knee; full) is questionable to play Sunday against Tampa Bay.
 OLB  Thomas Incoom (calf; DNP) out
 OLB  Jaelan Phillips (hamstring; DNP) out
 LB  Bam Martin-Scott (hamstring; full) questionable
 Chicago Bears 5-2 INJURIES 
 TE Cole Kmet suffered a season-ending knee injury in Chicago's win over the Patriots, head coach Ben Johnson confirmed. The Bears placed Kmet on injured reserve.
 SUSPENSIONS 
 DE Montez Sweat 's was activated from the reserve/suspended list.
 Cleveland Browns 4-2 INJURIES 
 RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) has no designation for Sunday's game against the Titans.
 RB  Dylan Sampson (knee) is questionable to play Sunday.
 G Teven Jenkins (back) is out Sunday.
 DT Mike Hall (ankle) out
 LB Quincy Williams (neck) questionable
 CB Denzel Ward (hand) was added to the injury report on Friday and is questionable to play.
 S Grant Delpit (concussion/shoulder) questionable
 Dallas Cowboys 2-4 INJURIES 
 WR George Pickens (shoulder) practiced in full Friday after being limited Thursday.
 WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) did not practice.
 OT Tyler Guyton (calf) full
 OT Broderick Jones (wrist) was limited in practice.
 OT Drew Shelton (hamstring) DNP
 LB Marist Liufau (forearm) full
 LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) full
 LB Dee Winters (calf) DNP
 CB Cobie Durant (hamstring) full
 CB Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) full
 S  P.J. Locke (foot) was designated to return from injured reserve and had his 21-day practice window activated. Locke was limited in his first practice back.
 Denver Broncos 4-2 INJURIES 
 RB Tyler Badie (thumb) is out Sunday against the Cardinals.
 RB  Jonah Coleman (ankle) is questionable to play.
 LB Jonah Elliss (ankle) out
 CB Patrick Surtain II (ankle) questionable
 S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) out
 Detroit Lions 3-2 INJURIES 
 C Cade Mays (wrist) is questionable to play Sunday against the Packers.
 DB Brian Branch (Achilles) questionable
 Green Bay Packers 4-2 INJURIES 
 RB Josh Jacobs is on track to play Sunday against the Lions as long as he keeps trending in the right direction, head coach Matt LaFleur said. Jacobs spent the past six weeks on the Commissioner's Exempt List.
 WR Bo Melton (back) is questionable to play.
 G Aaron Banks (knee/toe) questionable
 LB  Zaire Franklin (shin) is out Sunday.
 CB Benjamin St-Juste (hamstring) questionable
 Houston Texans 2-4 INJURIES 
 RB David Montgomery (groin) is out Sunday against the Giants.
 WR Tank Dell (knee) is questionable to play.
 OT Blake Fisher (thumb) out
 S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) out
 S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) out
 Indianapolis Colts 2-4 INJURIES 
 WR Anthony Gould (concussion) is out Sunday against the Vikings. 
 TE Tyler Warren (groin) out
 CB Sauce Gardner (calf) out
 P Rigoberto Sanchez (right foot) is questionable to play.
 Jacksonville Jaguars 4-2 INJURIES 
 LT Anton Harrison was revealed during his knee surgery Thursday to have suffered a torn ACL, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported. Harrison will miss the rest of the season.
 Kansas City Chiefs 5-0 SIGNINGS 
 RB Nate Carter (practice squad)
 WR  Andrew Armstrong (from practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
 OL Jaylon Moore (concussion) out
 CB L'Jarius Sneed (knee) is questionable to play.
 Las Vegas Raiders 3-3 INJURIES 
 RB Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is questionable to play Sunday against the Rams.
 WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) is out Sunday and will not be activated from injured reserve this weekend, Kubiak said.
 Los Angeles Rams 2-4 INJURIES 
 WR Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable to play Sunday against the Raiders. Nacua, who left practice early Thursday, did not participate Friday.
 LB Myles Garrett could possibly have his 21-day practice window opened next week, head coach Sean McVay said.
 LB Nate Landman (concussion) is out Sunday.
 CB Trent McDuffie (groin) questionable
 Miami Dolphins 0-5 INJURIES 
 LB Robert Beal Jr. (hamstring) is doubtful to play Sunday against the Jets.
 LB Willie Gay Jr. (illness) is questionable to play.
 CB Reese Taylor (quad) is out Sunday.
 S Kyle Louis (knee) questionable
 Minnesota Vikings 5-0 SIGNINGS 
 OLB Jihad Ward (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB DeeJay Dallas (practice squad)
 OT  Tristan Leigh (practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 RB Jordan Mason (finger) will be listed as questionable to play Sunday against the Colts but it's looking positive, head coach Kevin O'Connell said.
 New Orleans Saints 2-4 INJURIES 
 RB Alvin Kamara (back; limited) has no injury designation and will play against Pittsburgh.
 G Cesar Ruiz (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant and is questionable to play Sunday.
 DT Nathan Shepherd (illness) did not practice Friday and is questionable vs. the Steelers.
 K Daniel Carlson (NIR-personal) returned to practice as a full participant and has no injury designation.
 New York Giants 3-2-1 INJURIES 
 TE Theo Johnson (neck) is doubtful to play Sunday against the Texans.
 OT Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) is questionable to play.
 LB  Tremaine Edmunds is out for the season with a torn muscle in his chest, ESPN reported.
 LB Chauncey Golston (neck), who went on injured reserve earlier in October, will miss the rest of the season, per ESPN.
 CB Paulson Adebo (knee) questionable
 CB Greg Newsome II (concussion) out
 S Jevon Holland (concussion) questionable
 S Tyler Nubin (neck) questionable
 New York Jets 2-4 INJURIES 
 RB Breece Hall (quad) is questionable to play Sunday against the Dolphins.
 WR  Adonai Mitchell (finger) has no designation and will play Sunday.
 OL Dylan Parham (knee) questionable
 LB  Joseph Ossai (ankle) out
 LB Kiko Mauigoa (leg) out
 Philadelphia Eagles 2-4 ROSTER CUTS 
 TE E.J. Jenkins 
 INJURIES 
 RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) was limited in Friday's practice
 WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice.
 WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) DNP
 TE  Dallas Goedert (knee) DNP
 OT Fred Johnson (illness) liited
 G Landon Dickerson  (knee/pectoral) limited
 G Willie Lampkin (illness) limited
 G Tyler Steen (shoulder) limited
 C Drew Kendall (knee) was a full participant in practice.
 DT Moro Ojomo (abdomen) limited
 LB A.J. Epenesa (back) full
 LB Jonathan Greenard (ankle) DNP
 LB Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) limited
 LB Nolan Smith (concussion) DNP
 DB  Michael Carter II (abdomen) DNP
 Pittsburgh Steelers 4-2 INJURIES 
 RB Rico Dowdle (knee; limited) is questionable to play Sunday against the Saints.
 LB Alex Highsmith (groin) upgraded to full
 LB T.J. Watt (calf) upgraded to full
 CB Jalen Ramsey (wrist) upgraded to full
 S DeShon Elliott (knee) questionable
 San Francisco 49ers 6-0 ROSTER CUTS 
 DL Ogbo Okoronkwo 
 INJURIES 
 WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
 WR Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable to play.
 WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring) out
 DE Nick Bosa (calf) out
 CB Upton Stout (shoulder) questionable
 S Siran Neal (knee) questionable
 S Marques Sigle (ankle) out
 Seattle Seahawks 3-3 SIGNINGS 
 WR Irvin Charles (from practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 CB Trevon Diggs was released and then signed to the practice squad.
 INJURIES 
 RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) is out Sunday against the Chiefs.
 LB Demarcus Lawrence (knee) is questionable to play.
 LB Uchenna Nwosu (hip) questionable
 LB Drake Thomas (ankle) out
 LB Chazz Surratt (calf) out
 S Nick Emmanwori (hip) questionable
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 1-5 INJURIES 
 QB Baker Mayfield (right thumb) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers, but head coach Todd Bowles told reporters he will play following a three-game absence.
 WR Emeka Egbuka  (concussion/foot) is out Sunday.
 OT Luke Goedeke (calf) out
 S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) out
 Tennessee Titans 1-5 INJURIES 
 RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable to play Sunday against the Browns.
 WR Calvin Ridley (hip) questionable
 S Tony Adams (ankle) questionable
 S Kevin Winston Jr. (quad) questionable
